objective: Refactor the benchmark and validate every integrated model on a fixed subset, tracing paper reproduction to matched historical samples.
scope_note: Subset validation covers integration and matched populations; it does not establish full-paper table or bitwise generation reproduction. Detailed local execution records are excluded from source control.

requirements.item: Explicit backend requests and results with deterministic resource cleanup

combined_refactor_validation.scope: Retained subset campaigns do not establish native generation equivalence for the final combined source revision.
combined_refactor_validation.limits: Recorded-source checks do not verify current import completeness, dependencies, weights, audio or metrics.

requirements.item: Original sample seed propagation including subprocess and HTTP adapters
Preserve manifest variants and select historical protocol explicitly
Fixed subset with input hashes and matched historical population
Independently loaded versioned scorers with sample-level metric recovery
Dependency-scoped code, weights, worker environments and hardware provenance
Protocol and stage plan for protection, denoising, generation and scoring
Separate completion, protocol validity and cross-run comparability
Speaker-aware paired comparison and consistent timing provenance
Every integrated model: real generation, scoring, historical comparison where supported
CLI, documentation, website and HF integration with full checks

caveats: Subset checks do not establish full-paper table reproduction.
Historical results lacking weight revisions or seeds cannot establish bitwise generation equivalence.
Historical source data and result artifacts remain preserved.

timing_evidence.note: Raw seconds and exact scopes are retained. Current scopes have no audited common boundary or matched execution protocol. Guardrails and regression tests do not establish measurement comparability.
